quests.instruction: Listen and choose the matching word.
quests.hint: For 'sin,' touch your tongue tip to the ridge behind your teeth and let air hum through your nose; for 'sing,' lift the BACK of your tongue to the roof of your mouth instead, with your tongue tip touching nothing.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "sin." The /n/ is made with the tongue tip touching the ridge behind the teeth, air humming through the nose. "Sing" would lift the back of the tongue to the soft palate instead, for /ŋ/, with the tip touching nothing.
